free_tier_limits: Default: 1,000 requests per hour per API key; service-specific limits may vary. DEMO_KEY: 30 requests per IP per hour and 50 per IP per day.
rate_limits: Default: 1,000 requests per hour per API key across api.data.gov APIs; service-specific limits may vary. DEMO_KEY: 30 per IP per hour and 50 per IP per day.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: ORIGINAL 'unknown' is incorrect. OpenEI directs users to obtain a free api.data.gov key, whose current official manual publishes the stated default and DEMO_KEY limits: https://apps.openei.org/services/doc/rest/util_rates/?version=7 and https://api.data.gov/docs/developer-manual/. rate_limits: ORIGINAL 'not published' is incorrect; the same official manual publishes these limits while warning that service-specific limits may vary: https://api.data.gov/docs/developer-manual/.
